_comment: aterm TRAIL-LIGHT-COMPOSER baseline (docs/design/PRISM-GLASS.md §15.1 P0.12): trail-dark-composer's scene on Default Light (effects_harness --light), its terminal in the engine colours a window gives one on Default Light (its ink and ANSI slots) and its cursor family resolved by a focused window's law with its live cursor (resolve_glow_config on Default Light, the terminal's 1A7F37 cursor) from trail-dark-composer's knobs (cursor_trail_ms 650, cursor_trail_length 512 and cursor_trail_radius 0.4, not a default config's 260, 24 and 0.6; Rainbow Kitty reads only the duration of the three, so every figure here is a 650 ms trail's), the glow's dark_theme read off that ground as a window reads it (theme_is_dark), so the trail draws main's light (paper) arm: the GPU time as a reference full-repaint frame's p50 over the scene's (composer_gpu_rel), and the CPU work of the producer, the CPU raster and the GPU encode as frames per 10^9 instructions retired (_per_ginsn). BIGGER-IS-BETTER. Re-record with targo --unverified verify perf --record trail-light-composer. Re-recorded 2026-10-28 on box-4dea64151174cbad (M4 Pro 14c) when the terminal took Default Light's engine colours (aterm-bench b879d6128f): light now costs less than dark, as P0.14 found in the app (3.83M emit instructions a frame against dark's 5.96M, under_quads_max 5,835 against 14,881). Re-recorded again that day, on a quiet machine (load 12.9 at the lane's start and 15.3 at its end, on 14 cores), when the cursor family took a window's config law and live cursor (aterm-bench f5782f170b): against this box's run of main's 8ffb44c7da without that change, at one GPU operating point (ref_gpu_p50_us 1172.8 there, 1171.5 here), nothing moved past noise (emit 261.202 to 261.340, raster 362.203 to 362.249, encode 882.187 to 887.190, composer_gpu_rel 1.989 to 1.971). The record before this one read composer_gpu_rel 1.762 at ref_gpu_p50_us 285.0, another operating point, so its rise to 1.971 is not a change in the work. On 2026-10-28 this box ran the scene once at f5782f170b as committed and once with a local edit of GlowHost::new to a default config's 260 ms, 24 and 0.6 (not committed): the edit laid the same under and fx quads (p50, mean and max: 4,469, 4,224 and 5,835 under) and moved the emit and raster instructions by 0.05 % or less (p50 and mean), the encode's by +1.2 % (p50) and +0.8 % (mean).
